reviews.title: Painful
reviews.text:
The phone portion is great. And the watch app was perfect! Then they did an update or too and now the watch portion requires way too many steps to make a change to marking my ball, changing the lie, and the club. And then scoring the hole even after I left the green. 

Let me be clear, this has been a wonderful app. But they messed up the watch app and it is no longer simple and easy like it used to be.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: They say it’s free then you find out it’s free to try! That’s false!

reviews.title: Watch doesn’t work with future updates
reviews.text: Hole 19 seemed like a great idea and it does work but I have just discovered it’s obsolete because it no longer supports my Watch . I now have to pay £400 for a new watch in addition to the annual subscription- beware !!

reviews.title: Got worse over the years
reviews.text: Had this app for 4 plus years and it just keeps getting worse.  Sometimes it works sometimes it doesn’t. The Apple Watch sometimes automatically flips hole to hole, sometimes it doesn’t. You can’t close out the app on Apple Watch w/o closing the app on the iPhone. Can’t set defaults easily least to just to distance, I don’t want or need scoring, or the other stuff. I pay for the subscription and I still get ‘junk’ alerts and marketing things. It also seems like they stop updating and supporting it.

reviews.title: Battery Drain issues
reviews.text: A great app but even after you close it down it still drains your battery.  Using IOS 26.6.1  on iPhone and Apple Watch

reviews.title: No green maps
reviews.text: I am now stuck for the year with this app because I paid. Had I known there is no green map I wouldn’t have purchased this app. My rating will remain 2 stars until it catches up with the industry on green maps feature. I never thought something this simple will be omitted.

reviews.title: Payments
reviews.text: I agreed to the monthly subscription and not the immediate purchase and you guys have flipped my account upside two days in a row where I have to go into my bank and sign paperwork to get my money back wtf

reviews.title: Stupid app, infiltrated by scammers
reviews.text: Barely downloaded the app, hadn’t even used it for golfing once when when i started getting app messages from scammers… russian brides and such. I Do NOT recommend this app.

reviews.title: Porn related mentions
reviews.text: An app. that allows porn related mentions with no way to delete them. I’ll pass.

reviews.title: Auto shot detection?
reviews.text: Got the intelligence. At the end of each hole it asks how many shots? That’s what I thought it was supposed to do?

reviews.title: Difficult to Use
reviews.text: Cannot find anywhere in the app how to change tees from default. I also click on track shot but it never shows the distance when I arrive at my ball. Wish I would have stuck with the free version as the pay version is not very user friendly or worth the cost

reviews.title: Updated 10 times today
reviews.text: This is getting ridiculous

reviews.title: 9 hole options
reviews.text: Kind of ridiculous that there no option to just select a front of back 9 when starting a round in the free version.

reviews.title: Premium useless
reviews.text:
Paid for premium and just doesn’t deliver 
Help desk useless

reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: Beware they take your money before trial period ends and then won’t answer emails. Not a good app there are better options for less money

reviews.title: Slooooooow
reviews.text: The app has become super slow since they made an update to track your shot substance. Such a pain to use now and I paid for the full year already.

reviews.title: Mentality
reviews.text: Upgraded to intelligence and nothing happens!  Taken money but no upgrade. Very Poor.

reviews.title: Ad ruins experience
reviews.text: I understand ads on the free version but on one hole early in the round I couldn’t dismiss the ad, couldn’t view the hole or gps data, and couldn’t input my score for that hole. Frustrating and ruined my scoring.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: Ai said free. You have 14 day free trial then 69.00 p/y. I just need yardage around green area since I have no depth perception.

reviews.title: New player
reviews.text: Not user friendly

reviews.title: Rubbish!!!
reviews.text: I used this app playing 10 rounds of golf.  1. It drains the watch battery quickly,, 2. Mid round the app freezes on my iPhone 17 pro, 3. Can’t track your shots on the watch properly, 4. The AI feature should be FREE.  Overall, this app is not worth a penny

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: After several weeks without purchases the dreaded free trial appeared. You can’t move on until you try the Free Trial. You can’t go back to how it was. So by now I want just delete my account. Going forward means subscribing and your Apple Pay account. Talk about backing you up against a wall with a gun at your head. I just deleted the complete app and good ridance.
